## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -3.55% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing while credit stress signals conflict via HYG (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +0.54%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.44% | 1M: -0.29%) BELOW TREND, and SPY (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +0.54%) CORRECTION — mixed confirmations support a neutral call.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -3.55% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit stress rising: Credit spread (HYG/LQD level 0.7323) ↑ rising with HYG (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +0.54%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: -0.44% | 1M: -0.29%) BELOW TREND. Reflation tilt: CPER (1W: +2.28% | 1M: +8.84%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-cautious: TLT (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -1.62%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and yield curve (1W: -0.89% | 1M: -2.20%) BELOW TREND flattening. Dollar recovering: Dollar Strength (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY → flat.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy and Industrials leading while Tech lagging: XLE (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and ITA (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND, vs XLK (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -0.09%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Financials mixed: XLF (1W: -1.44% | 1M: +4.32%) CORRECTION — style mixed / no clear leadership given 4/11 breadth.

5. US vs Global?  
US large caps soft: SPY (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +0.54%) CORRECTION, while EM strength persists: EEM (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Regional breadth favors EM/Asia vs the US for now.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation subdued: Speculation Index below trend and ARKK (1W: -2.90% | 1M: +0.12%) CORRECTION and IWM (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +1.81%) CORRECTION show pullback, while IBIT (1W: +2.99% | 1M: -1.41%) RECOVERY signals selective risk-on in crypto beta.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Reflation bias: CPER (1W: +2.28% | 1M: +8.84%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +0.81% | 1M: +23.75%) ABOVE TREND showing commodity-led strength, while GLD (1W: -3.31% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION is digesting gains.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy leadership with dispersion: XLE (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -2.01%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: -2.66% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND show mixed crude/gas dynamics.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: VXX (1W: -3.55% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND and CPER (1W: +2.28% | 1M: +8.84%) ABOVE TREND. MAJOR divergence across core ETFs (SPY (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +0.54%) CORRECTION, XLF (1W: -1.44% | 1M: +4.32%) CORRECTION, IWM (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +1.81%) CORRECTION, GLD (1W: -3.31% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION) signals a transitional market—suppress strong directional conviction.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals showing strength: XLE (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to lagging Tech: XLK (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -0.09%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -1.73% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND. Bonds neutral-to-monitor given TLT (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -1.62%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND; ITA (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -0.09%) BELOW TREND; XLF (1W: -1.44% | 1M: +4.32%) CORRECTION.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.28% | 1M: +8.84%) ABOVE TREND; SLV (1W: +0.81% | 1M: +23.75%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: GLD (1W: -3.31% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION; UNG (1W: -2.66% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) with VXX (1W: -3.55% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND. HYG/LQD ~0.73 (credit health pivot) with credit spread ↑ rising. XLK/XLF ~2.0 (tech vs finance pivot) as a watch ratio given XLK (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -0.09%) BELOW TREND and XLF (1W: -1.44% | 1M: +4.32%) CORRECTION.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and signals mixed between easing fear (VXX) and rising credit stress (HYG/LQD). Energy and EM are showing relative strength while Tech shows weakness; key risk is the MAJOR divergence across SPY, XLF, IWM and GLD that makes the market transitional—monitor for resolution.
